annotations.text:
Mathematical minimalism, mobile first.
Each direction answers 'what is this page about?' in the first screen, which the current site does not.

A · Specimen
Leads with one worked example: 13 -> 31, both prime, so it is drawn. The idea is legible before you scroll.
Tradeoff: spends the top of the screen on one example.

B · Definition
A boxed definition block, like the top of a paper. Most compact, most 'mathematical'.
Tradeoff: reads as documentation, less inviting.

C · Mirror
The reversal is the whole hero: number above, mirrored below, dark ground so the lattice carries the page.
Tradeoff: dark UI is a bigger departure, and the plot must be redrawn for it.
